description.en: Planned whole-organism study featuring elongated flattened body with front and rear cap shells joined by tiled sclerites.
description.zh: 拟议全体生物研究：长扁体前后各具帽壳，中间覆盖叠片骨片。

scientific_scope.en: Genus-level living reconstruction planning study; named fossil morphology informs the proposal, with uncertain soft anatomy kept explicit.
scientific_scope.zh: 属级活体复原规划，参考具名化石形态；软组织等不确定部分须明确标注。

distinctness.en: Its distinguishing construction is elongated flattened body with front and rear cap shells joined by tiled sclerites; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant.
distinctness.zh: 以长扁体前后各具帽壳，中间覆盖叠片骨片为独立造型依据；须保留这些结构差异，不能仅靠换色、缩放或姿势区别。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly direction: establish elongated flattened body with front and rear cap shells joined by tiled sclerites in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以长扁体前后各具帽壳，中间覆盖叠片骨片搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

uncertainty: The source supports the named form; coloration, posture, soft tissues and fine proportions are not all established.
reference_notes: The era is a representative planning interval, not a full stratigraphic range or a coexistence claim. Verify the selected species, locality and specimen before a place-specific scene.

sources.title: The Early Cambrian Halkieria is a mollusc
sources.supports: Halkieria anterior/posterior shells, sclerite covering and disputed systematic placement.
